title: D2P Draped Panel Mesh
description: Derived positions of one panel's rest mesh after draping (design decision ADR-029 §5). It holds positions only: the triangles, UVs and edge bindings are those of the rest mesh, so every draped vertex still references its pattern position and no domain binding uses a mesh index (TOP-008).

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

createdAt.description: When the document was produced (UTC). Excluded from the resultDigest.

restMeshRef.description: The flat rest mesh (d2p:panel-mesh-result) that was draped; 'digest' is its resultDigest.

positionsM.description: Draped vertex positions in the scene frame (m). Vertex i is vertex i of the rest mesh, so it keeps its UV and its pattern position; triangles are those of the rest mesh (D2P-SEM-129).

personalDerived.description: True when the document derives from a body measurement profile classified 'personal' or 'sensitive-personal' (directly or through a pinned body model or scene). Such a document is geometry or data derived from personal data and is served only under the export rules of that profile; a document that derives from such a profile without stating true is reported as D2P-SEM-050. Absent means false.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest).
